title: WordPress 7.1 Media Processing Race Enables Persistent PHP File Write and Author-to-RCE
vulnerabilityInformation: A race condition vulnerability was discovered in WordPress 7.1 that allowed authenticated users with Author role to achieve persistent arbitrary PHP execution. The vulnerability involved exploiting media finalization, URL-media sideload, and image post-processing flows to generate persistent image files with PHP extensions containing PHP code in image metadata. The issue was confirmed in WordPress 7.1 development versions from Beta 2 through RC2, but was not present in the current 7.0 branch. The vulnerability required a PHP-served writable temporary directory and successful exploitation of a race condition window between multiple REST API calls.
